metadata.mechanics: This procedure may Target 5 to 10 people, requires at least 5. Videbit Mortis allows players to engage echoes of dead NPCs from the local branch's history. These scenes can reveal information, provide guidance and/or tie into Local plot but cannot reveal Pre-Fall or non-Local information. The nature and mechanics of these scenes will vary and can be deadly.
metadata.notes: Requires 1 month written notice for preparation.
metadata.descriptionOfRoleplay: Diving into the Mortis requires time, preparation, and intent if certain information is sought. First, the individual conducting the procedure must find, preferably, a biological specimen of the one they seek. This could be a sample of blood, hair, or – in a pinch – a close relation. This sample is used as an Infection-fueled focus that is combined with various other ingredients and, most importantly, concentrated Infection. This poisonous concoction is then eaten by each individual attempting the dive, and their bodies immediately collapse to the ground. Those conducting the procedure also find that doing an advance talk of the person they’re seeking, what is known about them, and what they want answered may assist in making sure the procedure goes smoothly
